question: Should collecting two oil flasks replace the existing lantern objective or be an additional objective? Please select the oil-flask item as well, since it is absent from the supplied index.
answer: The quest is The Drowned Bell (the lantern is needed to cross the marsh). There is no oil flask item yet: add an Oil Flask item and an objective in stage 1 ('The marsh gate') to collect 2 oil flasks. Keep the other objectives as they are.
